# SuiteCloud Development Framework

SuiteCloud Development Framework (1182 pages): SuiteCloud Development Framework

## Chapters
- [SuiteCloud Development Framework](chapter_4702622163.md): SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) is a development framework that you can use to create SDF SuiteApps, or to customize NetSuite accounts, using an integrated development environment (IDE) on your local computer.
  - [Getting Started with SuiteCloud Development Framework](chapter_4702629975.md): You can get started with SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) by learning from the following topics: - SuiteCloud Development Framework Setup(https://docs.
  - [Developing SuiteCloud Projects for SuiteCloud Development Framework](chapter_4702631445.md): The following topics provide information about SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) tasks: - Account Component Imports to SuiteCloud Projects(https://docs.
  - [Developing SDF Custom Objects](section_4738081469.md): The following topics provide information about developing XML definitions for SDF custom objects in a SuiteCloud project for SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF), and validation of SDF custom objects when deploying those projects to a target NetSuite account: SDF Object Format and Rules - Downloading the XML Definition of an Object from a NetSuite Account(https://docs.
  - [Conversion of a Bundle to an Account Customization Project for SDF](chapter_4849384524.md): Note: SuiteBundler is still supported, but it will not be updated with any new features.
  - [SuiteCloud Development Framework XML Reference](SDFxml.md): This reference documentation outlines the XML definitions of SDF custom objects that are supported in SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF).
  - [SuiteCloud Development Framework Error Handling](chapter_1497980061.md): SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) provides extensive validation of SDF custom objects in SuiteCloud projects to catch errors that may occur during the deployment process.
